items.source: Spring Data has its own type for vector representation org.springframework.data.domain.Vector. While this can be used as a wrapper around a float or double array, Spring Data Neo4j supports only the double variant right now. From a user perspective, it is possible to only define the Vector interface on the property definition and use either double or float. Neo4j will store both double and float variants as a 64-bit Cypher FLOAT value, which is consistent with values persisted through Cypher and the dedicated setNodeVectorProperty function that Spring Data Neo4j uses to persist the property.
items.translation: Spring Data 拥有用于向量表示的专用类型 `org.springframework.data.domain.Vector`。虽然该类型可作为 `float` 或 `double` 数组的包装器使用，但 Spring Data Neo4j 目前仅支持 `double` 变体。从用户角度来看，只需在属性定义中指定 `Vector` 接口，即可同时使用 `double` 或 `float`。Neo4j 会将 `double` 和 `float` 两种变体均存储为 64 位 Cypher `FLOAT` 值，这与通过 Cypher 持久化的值以及 Spring Data Neo4j 用于持久化该属性的专用函数 `setNodeVectorProperty` 所处理的数据类型保持一致。

items.source: If you need conversions only for some specific attributes, we provide @ConvertWith. This is an annotation that can be put on attributes of both entities (@Node) and relationship properties (@RelationshipProperties) It defines a Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter via the converter attribute and an optional Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverterFactory to construct the former. With an implementation of Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter all specific conversions for a given type can be addressed. In addition, @ConvertWith also provides converterRef for referencing any Spring bean in the application context implementing Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter. The referenced bean will be preferred over constructing a new converter.
items.translation: 如果您仅需对某些特定属性进行转换，我们提供 `@ConvertWith`。 这是一个注解，可以应用于实体（`@Node`）的属性以及关系属性（`@RelationshipProperties`）上。 它通过 `converter` 属性定义一个 `Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter`，并可选地提供一个 `Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverterFactory` 来构建前者。 通过实现 `Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter`，可以处理给定类型的特定转换需求。 此外，`@ConvertWith` 还提供 `converterRef` 属性，用于引用应用程序上下文中实现 `Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter` 的任意 Spring Bean；被引用的 Bean 将优先于新构建的转换器使用。

items.source: With @CompositeProperty, attributes of type Map<String, Object> or Map<? extends Enum, Object> can be stored as composite properties. All entries inside the map will be added as properties to the node or relationship containing the property. Either with a configured prefix or prefixed with the name of the property. While we only offer that feature for maps out of the box, you can Neo4jPersistentPropertyToMapConverter and configure it as the converter to use on @CompositeProperty. A Neo4jPersistentPropertyToMapConverter needs to know how a given type can be decomposed to and composed back from a map.
items.translation: 使用@CompositeProperty，可以将类型为Map<String, Object>或Map<? extends Enum, Object>的属性存储为复合属性。 映射中的所有条目都将作为属性添加到包含该属性的节点或关系上。 这些属性可以配置前缀，或使用属性名称本身作为前缀。 虽然我们默认只为 Map 提供此功能，但您可以使用Neo4jPersistentPropertyToMapConverter并将其配置为在@CompositeProperty上使用的转换器。Neo4jPersistentPropertyToMapConverter需要知道如何将给定类型分解为映射，以及如何从映射重新组合回该类型。

items.source: String formatted as ISO 8601 Date (yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss.SSSZ). Notice the Z: SDN will store all java.util.Date instances in UTC. If you require the time zone, use a type that supports it (i.e. ZoneDateTime) or store the zone as a separate property.
items.translation: 格式为 ISO 8601 日期（yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ）。请注意其中的 Z：SDN 将存储所有 java.util.Date 实例于 UTC。如果您需要时区信息，请使用支持该功能的类型（即 ZoneDateTime），或将时区作为单独的属性进行存储。

items.source: If you prefer to work with your own types in the entities or as parameters for @Query annotated methods, you can define and provide a custom converter implementation. First you have to implement a GenericConverter and register the types your converter should handle. For entity property type converters you need to take care of converting your type to and from a Neo4j Java Driver Value. If your converter is supposed to work only with custom query methods in the repositories, it is sufficient to provide the one-way conversion to the Value type.
items.translation: 如果您希望在实体中使用自己的类型，或将其作为带有 `@Query` 注解的方法的参数，则可以定义并提供自定义转换器实现。 首先，您需要实现一个 `GenericConverter`，并注册您的转换器应处理的类型。 对于实体属性类型的转换器，您需要确保能够将您的类型转换为 Neo4j Java Driver 的 `Value`，并能从该 `Value` 转换回您的类型。 如果您的转换器仅用于仓库中的自定义查询方法，则只需提供向 `Value` 类型的一向转换即可。

items.source: To make SDN aware of your converter, it has to be registered in the Neo4jConversions. To do this, you have to create a @Bean with the type org.springframework.data.neo4j.core.convert.Neo4jConversions. Otherwise, the Neo4jConversions will get created in the background with the internal default converters only.
items.translation: 为了让 SDN 识别您的转换器，必须将其注册到Neo4jConversions中。为此，您需要创建一个类型为org.springframework.data.neo4j.core.convert.Neo4jConversions的@Bean。否则，Neo4jConversions将在后台仅使用内部默认转换器进行创建。

items.source: We provide @DateLong and @DateString as meta-annotated annotations for backward compatibility with Neo4j-OGM schemes not using native types. Those are meta annotated annotations building on the concept above.

items.source: The converter uses any Spring Converter registered with it to override the default mapping of object properties to node fields and values.
items.translation: 转换器使用与其注册的任意Spring 转换器来覆盖对象属性到节点字段和值的默认映射。

items.source: The fields of an object are used to convert to and from fields in the graph. Public JavaBean properties are not used.
items.translation: 对象的字段用于在对象字段与图字段之间进行转换。 不使用公共的 `JavaBean` 属性。

items.source: We support a broad range of conversions out of the box. Find the list of supported cypher types in the official drivers manual: Type mapping.

items.source:
The Neo4j Converter has a few conventions for mapping objects when no additional mapping metadata is provided.
The conventions are:
items.translation: Neo4j 转换器在缺少额外映射元数据时，遵循一些对象映射约定。这些约定如下：

items.source:
If you have a single non-zero-argument constructor whose constructor argument names match top-level property names of node, that constructor is used.
Otherwise, the zero-argument constructor is used.
If there is more than one non-zero-argument constructor, an exception will be thrown.
items.translation: 如果存在一个具有单个非零参数的构造函数，且该构造函数的参数名称与节点的顶级属性名称匹配，则使用该构造函数。否则，使用无参构造函数。如果存在多个具有非零参数的构造函数，将抛出异常。
